person_note: The book sustains different narrative persons: Alex Cross narrates his chapters as a participating first-person I, while chapters centered on the antagonists use nonparticipating third-person narration. The diagnostic Goodreads material exposes the first-person route but provides no secure third-person passage; dialogue and clipped fragments were not promoted to base evidence. The Tier A opening excerpt directly demonstrates multiple chapter-length switches, and the whole-book Tier C review says the pattern continues throughout. Because support for the complete structure rests on one opening excerpt plus one weaker whole-book source, rather than two independent Tier A/B sources or quote support for both persons, confidence is medium rather than high.
